text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to interpret and understand visual information from the world, such as images and videos. One of its core tasks is image recognition, which involves identifying what is in a picture, like a cat or a tree. Another important function is object detection, where the system not only recognizes objects but also locates them precisely within a frame. This technology has many practical applications, from sorting photos on your phone to monitoring security cameras. Perhaps the most exciting use is in self-driving cars, where computer vision helps vehicles spot pedestrians, traffic signs, and other cars to navigate safely.
